name: product-recalls
description: Check stock lists against consumer-product recalls.

interface.longDescription:
Check my store inventory for product recalls before I list items for sale, a recall screening step for resellers and small business sellers.

Screen up to 100 inventory items before listing them for resale. Supply a product name and optional brand, model number or UPC. Identifier matches and possible product-word matches show the recall number, date, hazard, remedy, source page and match reason. Download XLSX and CSV files with a blank Action taken column for shop records.

Search recall records by product, brand or hazard keywords and an inclusive date range, or read full records by recall number. The search export includes up to the newest 2,000 matches.

Limits: consumer-product recalls only; food, drugs and vehicle databases are outside coverage. Matching uses UPCs, model numbers printed in recall text, and product/brand words. Models written with spaces and products described differently can be missed. Word matches are marked Possible match - verify. No matching recall found in CPSC data does not establish absence of a recall; check the source page and product label before selling. Inventory coverage begins at the chosen year, earliest 2000; the default is the last 15 calendar years. Failed source years are disclosed. This is a screening aid, not legal advice. Generated files expire in about an hour.
defaultPrompt: Check my inventory for recalls: thermal laminator, model TL1302Z, since 2026.
Consumer product recall search for laminator from 10/01/2026 through 10/21/2026.
Get the full record for recall number 27024.

positive.prompt: Check my inventory for recalls: thermal laminator, model TL1302Z, since 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Recall found; Model number exact (normalized). Recall 27024, dated 2026-10-15. Includes screening downloads and the source coverage statement.

positive.prompt: Consumer product recall search for laminator from 10/01/2026 through 10/21/2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 1 matching recall records with XLSX and CSV downloads and the source coverage statement.

positive.prompt: Show the full record for consumer product recall number 27024.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recall 27024, dated 2026-10-15, with description, contact, units and image links.

positive.prompt: Recall check by upc: pain relieving ointment, UPC 860006498115, recalls since 2025.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Recall found; UPC exact. Recall 26157, dated 2025-12-18. Includes screening downloads and the source coverage statement.

positive.prompt: Check my inventory for recalls: zzqq widget, since 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns No matching recall found in CPSC data. Includes screening downloads and the source coverage statement.

negative.description: Food recall databases are outside coverage. Expected: do not call.
Vehicle equipment recalls are outside coverage. Expected: do not call.
negative.prompt: Check my car tires for vehicle recalls.

negative.description: Legal conclusions are outside coverage. Expected: do not call.
negative.prompt: Give a legal opinion on whether I can resell this item.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: live inventory recall screening, keyword search, full recall records, and XLSX and CSV screening files.

pl-PL.subtitle: Kontrola wycofań produktów
pl-PL.description: Sprawdź do 100 pozycji magazynowych w aktualnych rejestrach wycofań produktów konsumenckich. Wyszukuj według słów, numeru modelu lub UPC, czytaj szczegóły i pobieraj pliki XLSX i CSV. Dopasowania słowne wymagają sprawdzenia. Brak dopasowania nie potwierdza braku wycofania. Pliki wygasają po około godzinie.

de-DE.subtitle: Rückrufe im Bestand prüfen
de-DE.description: Prüfen Sie bis zu 100 Lagerartikel anhand aktueller Rückrufdaten für Verbraucherprodukte. Suchen Sie nach Begriffen, Modellnummer oder UPC und laden Sie XLSX- und CSV-Dateien herunter. Worttreffer müssen überprüft werden. Ein fehlender Treffer schließt einen Rückruf nicht aus. Dateien verfallen nach etwa einer Stunde.

es-ES.subtitle: Revisa retiradas de productos
es-ES.description: Revisa hasta 100 artículos del inventario con registros actuales de retiradas de productos de consumo. Busca por palabras, modelo o UPC, consulta detalles y descarga XLSX y CSV. Las coincidencias por palabras requieren verificación. La ausencia de coincidencias no confirma la ausencia de una retirada. Los archivos caducan en aproximadamente una hora.

fr-FR.subtitle: Vérifier les rappels produits
fr-FR.description: Vérifiez jusqu’à 100 articles avec les données actuelles de rappels de produits de consommation. Recherchez par mots, modèle ou UPC et téléchargez des fichiers XLSX et CSV. Les correspondances par mots nécessitent une vérification. Aucun résultat ne confirme pas l’absence de rappel. Les fichiers expirent après environ une heure.

ja-JP.subtitle: 在庫の製品リコール確認
ja-JP.description: 消費者製品の最新リコール記録と最大100件の在庫を照合します。キーワード、型番、UPCで検索し、詳細を確認してXLSX・CSVをダウンロードできます。単語の一致は確認が必要です。一致なしはリコールがないことの証明にはなりません。ファイルは約1時間で失効します。

pt-BR.subtitle: Verifique recalls no estoque
pt-BR.description: Confira até 100 itens do estoque com registros atuais de recalls de produtos de consumo. Pesquise por palavras, modelo ou UPC, consulte detalhes e baixe XLSX e CSV. Correspondências por palavras exigem verificação. Nenhuma correspondência não confirma a ausência de recall. Os arquivos expiram em cerca de uma hora.
